name: source-initialization-profiling
goal: Record actual completed initialization of registered data modules through Harness without substituting initialization for callable work or inventing failed/type-only profiles.

evidence: Source runners cover declared callables but cannot time data/schema initialization at module scope without wrapping exports in a function. Existing profiler has no completion-scope API. Actual registered data import currently emits no measurements.

Add standard profiler scope cases for actual elapsed work, idempotent finish, unfinished and invalid subjects. Extend normal runner tests with actual data initialization, failed imports and type-only source; preserve existing callable/generator cases.
Committed14a71502 redde3d4bb2: two actual profiler cases fail because beginScope is absent; the registered data import also lacks its two observations. Five boundary cases already pass.

Add idempotent completed scopes to the existing profiler and admit only inspected data initializers in the adapter. Skip callable definitions, helper contracts and profiler bootstrap dependencies; failed scopes never reach finish.

21 focused cases pass; eight scope/runner cases rerun unchanged after lint extraction. Types, lint, audit, registry, API declarations/build and two packed-consumer tests pass. Bootstrap profiles remain required via explicit workloads.

The isolated pre-scope snapshot lacks beginScope and data-import observations; repaired source passes the same cases. Failed initialization and type-only modules remain unobserved, callable profiles are not replaced.
